points.title: 童年成长
points.description: 路易斯·阿姆斯特朗出生于新奥尔良的贫民区，由祖母抚养长大。童年时期，他曾在街头卖艺谋生，并在少年感化所学习音乐。正是在新奥尔良这个爵士乐的摇篮，他接触到了早期的爵士音乐传统，尤其是巴德·博登的铜管乐队。这段经历为他后来的音乐生涯奠定了基础，培养了他即兴演奏的技巧和对音乐的热爱。
points.descriptionEn: Louis Armstrong was born in the impoverished Black Storyville district of New Orleans and was raised by his grandmother. During his childhood, he worked odd jobs and sang on the streets for money. It was in New Orleans, the cradle of jazz, that he was exposed to early jazz traditions, particularly in the brass bands of Buddy Bolden. This formative period laid the foundation for his future musical career, developing his improvisational skills and love for music.

points.title: 职业起步
points.description: 1922年，阿姆斯特朗应约瑟夫·'金'·奥利弗的邀请前往芝加哥，加入克里奥尔爵士乐队。在芝加哥期间，他迅速成长为小号手和歌手，并开始发展自己独特的演奏风格。1923年，他参与了奥利弗的录音，这是他首次出现在录音作品中。这段时期，他吸收了芝加哥爵士乐的影响，同时保持了自己新奥尔良的根源，形成了独特的音乐语言。
points.descriptionEn: In 1922, Armstrong moved to Chicago at the invitation of Joseph 'King' Oliver to join the Creole Jazz Band. During his time in Chicago, he quickly emerged as a talented trumpeter and vocalist, beginning to develop his distinctive playing style. In 1923, he participated in Oliver's recordings, marking his first appearance on record. During this period, he absorbed Chicago jazz influences while maintaining his New Orleans roots, forming a unique musical language.

points.title: 艺术突破
points.description: 1924年，阿姆斯特朗加入弗莱彻·亨德森的乐队，在纽约的棉花俱乐部等场所演出。在纽约期间，他的小号演奏技巧达到了新的高度，引入了即兴独奏的概念，彻底改变了爵士乐的演奏方式。1926年，他组建了自己的热力五重奏，录制了著名的'西尾街布鲁斯'和'土豆头'等作品，这些录音确立了他在爵士乐界的地位。这一时期，他不仅是一位杰出的演奏家，还发展出了独特的沙哑唱腔，开创了声乐爵士的新风格。
points.descriptionEn: In 1924, Armstrong joined Fletcher Henderson's orchestra in New York, performing at venues like the Cotton Club. During his New York years, his trumpet playing reached new heights as he introduced the concept of improvised solos, revolutionizing jazz performance. In 1926, he formed his Hot Five quintet and recorded iconic pieces like 'West End Blues' and 'Potato Head Blues,' establishing his status in jazz. During this period, he not only became a virtuoso performer but also developed his distinctive gravelly vocal style, pioneering a new approach to vocal jazz.

points.title: 明星崛起
points.description: 1930年代，阿姆斯特朗开始在好莱坞电影中露面，如《巴黎狂热》(1938)，并成为全国知名的明星。在洛杉矶期间，他组建了路易斯·阿姆斯特朗和他的全明星乐队，这种大乐队形式使他能够展示他的即兴演奏技巧。这一时期，他的音乐风格更加商业化，但仍保持了艺术上的创新。他录制了许多经典曲目，如'What a Wonderful World'和'Hello, Dolly!'，这些作品使他成为美国文化的象征。他的表演风格和人格魅力使他超越了音乐界，成为美国种族和解的象征。
points.descriptionEn: In the 1930s, Armstrong began appearing in Hollywood films such as 'Parisian Skies' (1938) and became a national celebrity. During his Los Angeles years, he formed Louis Armstrong and His All Stars, a small band format that allowed him to showcase his improvisational skills. During this period, his musical style became more commercial while maintaining artistic innovation. He recorded many classics like 'What a Wonderful World' and 'Hello, Dolly!', making him an icon of American culture. His performance style and personal charisma transcended music, making him a symbol of racial reconciliation in America.

points.title: 晚年辉煌
points.description: 1946年后，阿姆斯特朗主要在纽约活动，继续巡演和录音。尽管健康问题日益严重，他仍然保持着旺盛的创作力和表演热情。1960年代，他录制了'What a Wonderful World'这首经典歌曲，这首歌后来成为他的代表作之一。他频繁出现在电视节目中，成为美国文化的国际大使。晚年，他积极参与民权运动，尽管方式温和，但通过音乐传递了平等与爱的信息。1971年，阿姆斯特朗在纽约逝世，但他的音乐遗产和影响力持续至今，被公认为爵士乐史上最重要的人物之一。
points.descriptionEn: After 1946, Armstrong primarily based himself in New York, continuing to tour and record. Despite increasingly serious health problems, he maintained his creative energy and performance enthusiasm. In the 1960s, he recorded 'What a Wonderful World,' which became one of his signature songs. He frequently appeared on television, serving as an international ambassador of American culture. In his later years, he participated in the civil rights movement, conveying messages of equality and love through his music. Armstrong died in New York in 1971, but his musical legacy and influence continue to this day, widely regarded as one of the most important figures in jazz history.

appraisal.zh: 路易斯·阿姆斯特朗被公认为爵士乐的奠基人与革新者，他引入即兴独奏概念，开创小号演奏新标准，沙哑唱腔影响无数后来歌手，并在种族隔离时期赢得国际声誉，成为美国文化的象征。另一种看法认为，他后期过于商业化，'汤姆叔叔'式形象被指强化种族刻板印象，民权运动高涨时立场温和、与白人主流合作，被认为不够激进，早年与黑帮人物的往来也引发争议。但无人否认他对爵士乐的根本性贡献及其作为非裔美国艺术家的历史意义。
appraisal.en: Louis Armstrong is widely celebrated as a founder and innovator of jazz: he introduced improvised solos, set new standards for trumpet playing, and his gravelly voice influenced countless singers, while achieving international fame under segregation and becoming an icon of American culture. Another view holds that his later work grew overly commercial, his 'Uncle Tom' persona was seen as reinforcing racial stereotypes, and his moderate stance and collaboration with the white mainstream during the civil rights era were judged insufficiently radical, with early gangster associations also stirring controversy. Yet none deny his fundamental contribution to jazz and his historical significance as an African American artist.

supporter.zh: 路易斯·阿姆斯特朗被誉为爵士乐的奠基人和革新者。他通过引入即兴独奏概念，彻底改变了爵士乐的演奏方式，开创了小号演奏的新标准。他的沙哑唱腔开创了声乐爵士的新风格，影响了无数后来的歌手。作为非裔美国艺术家，他在种族隔离时期取得了国际声誉，成为美国文化的象征。他的音乐传递了乐观、希望和爱的信息，超越了种族和文化的界限，成为世界和平与理解的象征。
supporter.en: Louis Armstrong is celebrated as a founder and innovator of jazz. By introducing the concept of improvised solos, he revolutionized jazz performance and set new standards for trumpet playing. His gravelly vocal style pioneered a new approach to vocal jazz, influencing countless singers. As an African American artist who achieved international fame during the era of segregation, he became an icon of American culture. His music conveyed messages of optimism, hope, and love, transcending racial and cultural boundaries to become a symbol of world peace and understanding.

critic.zh: 批评者认为阿姆斯特朗在后期过于商业化，牺牲了艺术创新以迎合大众口味。他的'汤姆叔叔'式形象和表演风格被一些评论家视为强化种族刻板印象。在民权运动高涨时期，他温和的立场和与白人主流的合作被批评为不够激进。此外，他的音乐生涯早期曾与黑帮人物有联系，这引发了一些争议。尽管如此，这些批评无法否认他对爵士乐发展的根本性贡献和作为非裔美国艺术家的历史意义。
critic.en: Critics argue that Armstrong's later work became overly commercial, sacrificing artistic innovation to appeal to mainstream audiences. His 'Uncle Tom' persona and performance style have been viewed by some as reinforcing racial stereotypes. During the height of the civil rights movement, his moderate stance and collaboration with white mainstream establishments were criticized as insufficiently radical. Additionally, his early associations with gangster figures have sparked controversy. Nevertheless, these criticisms cannot diminish his fundamental contributions to jazz development and his historical significance as an African American artist.

objective.zh: 从历史和文化视角看，路易斯·阿姆斯特朗是一位复杂的文化符号。他既是爵士乐技术革新的先驱，也是美国种族关系演变的见证者。他的音乐生涯跨越了爵士乐从地下音乐到主流艺术的转变过程。在流行文化中，他的形象被不断重塑，从天才音乐家到文化大使，再到种族和解的象征。阿姆斯特朗的遗产体现了美国文化的矛盾性：一方面是种族隔离的历史，另一方面是通过艺术实现的跨文化沟通。他的音乐和人格魅力使他成为20世纪美国最具辨识度的文化人物之一。
objective.en: From a historical and cultural perspective, Louis Armstrong is a complex cultural symbol. He was both a pioneer of jazz technical innovation and a witness to the evolution of American race relations. His career spanned jazz's transformation from underground music to mainstream art. In popular culture, his image has been continuously reshaped—from musical genius to cultural ambassador, to symbol of racial reconciliation. Armstrong's legacy embodies the contradictions of American culture: the history of racial segregation alongside cross-cultural communication achieved through art. His music and charisma make him one of the most recognizable cultural figures of 20th-century America.

self.zh: 如果你不得不问，那你就永远不会知道。
self.en: If you have to ask, you'll never know.
